calculate_reachable_range.description: Everywhere you can get to from one place inside a time or distance budget: a drive-time area, sometimes called an isochrone. The answer to 'which customers are within 30 minutes of this depot', 'how far can this van get before its next stop', or 'draw the catchment area of this branch'. Returns the boundary as a list of coordinates plus the box that contains it, so it can be drawn on a map or tested against a list of addresses. The start takes an address or coordinates; the budget defaults to 30 minutes by car.

description: Put TomTom's maps to work: search for places and addresses anywhere in the world, turn written addresses into coordinates and coordinates back into addresses, find everything of a given kind around a point, plan routes for cars, trucks, bikes or on foot with live traffic and a departure or arrival time, work out everywhere reachable inside a time or distance budget, and read the crashes, jams, closures and road works happening around any place right now.
